description: This file provides RPC client utilities for node management, including loading runtime modules, configuring CLI options, resolving node IDs, and handling authorization hints.

methods.name: loadNodesCliRpcRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the RPC runtime module for node RPC operations.

methods.name: nodesCallOpts
methods.description: Configures CLI command options for node RPC calls, including URL, token, timeout, and JSON output.

methods.name: callGatewayCli
methods.description: Calls the gateway CLI with specified method, options, and parameters, loading the runtime module if necessary.

methods.name: buildNodeInvokeParams
methods.description: Constructs parameters for invoking a node command, including generating a UUID if not provided.

methods.name: unauthorizedHintForMessage
methods.description: Provides hints for authorization errors based on message content.

methods.name: resolveNodeId
methods.description: Resolves a node ID from a query string.

methods.name: resolveNode
methods.description: Resolves a node object from a query string, attempting to list nodes and fallback to pairing list.
